1719-2645-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2645-3430-4644-5621.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4644-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-4247-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-4247-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

3899-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
3899-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat from step 4.

654-1308-4094-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-1308-4094-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2324-4050-7498-7541.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 5 life.
Grave Researcher is prepared.
2324-4050-7498-7541.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Biblioplex Tomekeeper, adding {B}.
Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Cast the copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}, returning Biblioplex Tomekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 4 life.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Grave Researcher.
Repeat.

2757-4222-7208.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pestered Wellguard.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

5016-6338-7711.manaNeeded: {2}{W} if you don't control your commander
5016-6338-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5016-6338-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Flawless Maneuver.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5016-6338-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

1824-3168-4549.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-3168-4549.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-3168-4549.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-2034-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3025-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3025-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

57-1115-3094-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1115-3094-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4594-6747-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4594-6747-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat.

339-677-1753-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

108-4013-6753.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2440-2703-4927.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

67-4681-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 2.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with Mana Cost Equal to {0}

2557-3182-3676-5751--1.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
2557-3182-3676-5751--1.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Tangleroot and Turntimber Sower trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Turntimber Sower trigger, creating two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G}, sacrificing the {0} cost creature and sacrificing the two Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2292-2525-2947.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

176-2438-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-2438-5522.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2089-2351-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
2089-2351-4050.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability riggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Symmetry Matrix triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping up to one Kraken you control.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

112-565-1283-4600.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {4}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

876-1171-1987-4125.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a copy of Black Lotus using Garth's ability.
You control at least one additional creature.
876-1171-1987-4125.description:
If needed, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Garth.
Activate Garth by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Garth and Shipwreck Dowser.
Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2160-2239-2697-3337.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} on your first turn, with {2}{R}{R} available on all subsequent turns
2160-2239-2697-3337.notablePrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
2160-2239-2697-3337.description:
Cast Last Chance by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
The Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, returning Last Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Last Chance triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn.
Repeat each turn.

650-2034-3175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.
